name: Trappeto (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal shield of Trappeto (quartered with a bend, bees, an anchor and wheat), with the inscription COMUNE DI TRAPPETO in black arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Trappeto, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 16 July 1996.

features.role: Trappeto arms — quartered with a bend, bees, an anchor and wheat
inscription COMUNE DI TRAPPETO arched above the arms
